question: Does the public Marshall Plate CXIV no. 532 image visually support the target-side M-2104 three-stroke U/pot cluster enough to validate the 700-034/UIII hypothesis?
finding: The public plate gives a genuine target-side raw image witness: a U/V- or pot-like element with an adjacent stroke group is visible for no. 532. The exact count is unresolved at this resolution. One reviewer reads three separable strokes with a possible fourth boundary; the adversarial read says four is plausible but insecure. Therefore the image keeps the M-2104 target visually testable but cannot validate 034 as the three-stroke component.
research_consequence: The M-2104 extraction is neither killed nor accepted by the public Marshall image. It moves from source-gated to image-reachable, with the next decisive requirement narrowed to a higher-resolution Plate CXIV/CISI/Harappa source image.
